answer: Bring your uncle's death certificate plus either the court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir; if there are several heirs, the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1. Because there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title, so the lost-title process for paid-off cars doesn't apply to you. The details of selling a car that still has a loan are in a separate article that isn't available here, so please contact a North Carolina store to confirm what's needed for the loan payoff.
